business_problem: Consider a global pharma company that would otherwise need to manually crawl through multiple platforms to identify suitable tenders among thousands available.
solution_summary: Cube RM modernized its analytics estate on Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Services, Azure AI Translator, moving from fragmented legacy tooling to a governed cloud data platform. Power BI then serves dashboards, self-service exploration, and decision support to business users at scale. "Azure OpenAI Service's use of large language models, which are pre-trained with vast amounts of data, eliminated the need for us to spend time training models from scratch." By capturing and filtering data with more efficiency and customization, Cube RM has brought improved outcomes, visibility, and revenue to its clients.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Runs large language model inference for summarization, extraction, conversational AI, and grounded answers.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Services
solution_components.role: Supplies prebuilt AI capabilities such as language, speech, or vision services within the application flow.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Translator
solution_components.role: Translates multilingual content and inputs inside the workflow.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Delivers dashboards, reports, and self-service analytics to business users.

solution_components.name: Power Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the low-code automation and application platform for workflow modernization.

data_flow: Content and operational context are prepared in the application data layer, passed to Azure OpenAI for generation or extraction, stored in Azure storage services, and returned through the user-facing application to employees or customers with grounded responses.
